_comment:
"If you've dealt arcane damage this turn, this gets +2{p}."

The release notes govern the ability type: 'checked while this is attacking on the combat chain' is an always-checking condition, so this is a WHILE_STATIC re-evaluated on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER - NOT a TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK pump (same lesson as Aggressive Pounce). A triggered pump would freeze the answer at attack declaration and miss arcane damage dealt between declaration and damage calculation, which release note two explicitly says must count ('this will have +2{p} during damage calculation').

EVENT_THIS_TURN event=damage qualifier=arcane reads the markers deal_damage records against the DEALING player once damage is final - past replacements/cancellation, amount > 0 (effect_keywords.py ~503-509) - so fully-prevented arcane damage does not count. player defaults to SELF = this card's controller: 'YOU'VE dealt arcane damage'. This exact condition shape is documented for this wording at condition_types.py ~1047.

WHILE_STATIC re-fires on every recalculation (declaration, after reactions, at damage calculation), so arcane damage dealt earlier in the turn or just before the damage step yields +2{p} there - matching release notes two and three. MODIFY_ATTACK under a recalc-type event applies transiently in the stage-8 window and does not accumulate across recalcs (effect_types.py ~4070-4080).

SOURCE_IS_ATTACK scopes the buff to this card's own attack (Savage Claw pattern); belt-and-braces here, since an Action - Attack is walked by the recalc listener as combat.attack_card.

amount 2 is this yellow printing's own printed_text (+2{p}); shape copied verbatim from the .drafts/arcanic_spike_blue.json sibling.
